question: Diagnose packaging reception, reported failure modes, their support and limits, and explicit buying, loyalty and remedy consequences. Keep product scope and source ownership precise.

count_definitions.arrival_leak: Focal TikTok accounts reporting or contextually agreeing to arrival leak, including bare agreements, excluding brand response/retailer.
count_definitions.explicit_loose_top: Focal TikTok accounts explicitly describing loose or improperly screwed top.
count_definitions.bare_arrival_agreement: Only terse same/same way agreement with no further report.
count_definitions.replacement_offered: Brand offer to send service replacement.
count_definitions.replacement_sent: Customer explicitly reports replacement sent; not confirmed delivered.

method: Update your own initial findings using additions. Preserve still-supported findings and revise affected conclusions. Earlier sources remain retrievable by key if the prior findings are insufficient.

prior_findings.report:
Initial stage: packaging reception is positive across several distinct TikTok accounts in one brand-owned video thread. P00’s chic/environmentally friendly statement has 296 displayed likes; P15’s planned reuse of an empty container has 150. These show visible resonance, not verified experiences or purchase effects. Aesthetic approval recurs across distinct accounts, but environmental performance does not receive independent factual corroboration: P01 is brand agreement, P03 is P00’s own qualified explanation, and P02 questions recyclability. Packaging SKU/version is generally unknown; the supplied product catalog cannot resolve it.

P06 alone reports arrival leakage with a loose top, opening and cleaning the product, and concern about oxygen exposure. This is one customer observation, with 12 likes, without independent corroboration in the supplied focal set. P07, the brand, says short exposure is not an issue and offers a replacement conditional on contacting support; this establishes an offer, not shipment, delivery, or independently verified product safety. No supplied focal account reports a replacement sent or retailer leakage. Positive aesthetics and this functional failure coexist; approval does not rebut the complaint. No defect rate or verified causal mechanism follows.

Consequences remain source-specific: P17 reports an all-Experiment routine and Continuum in transit, expressing loyalty without attributing it to packaging. P20 expresses broad buying enthusiasm without establishing completed checkout. P32 tentatively considers saving up; P38 intends to try; P42 reports receipt and newly discovered refillability. P04/P27 request refill bundles, P29 asks about a sticker in a refill, and P15 plans container reuse. None explicitly establishes future repeat purchase intent or packaging-caused purchase. P26 praises packaging while questioning skin benefits.

All focal observations were captured 2026-09-09T11:56:25.935Z; displayed publication dates omit the year. Raw likes are retained below; low counts lack enough exposure context to establish material resonance. Focal keys count source accounts/records as requested, not independent humans or events: P00/P03 share an actor, as do P01/P07. No context-only records were supplied. Coverage is bounded: 47 displayed bodies versus 72 advertised comments does not prove completeness; only selected reply branches were expanded, and native comment IDs are unavailable. A second-stage evidence set was not supplied, so second-stage findings and changes cannot be diagnosed. Counts below apply only to this initial focal set.

records.native_title: Love the product, hate the packaging
records.native_body: I do actually love this product across the board. The problem is with the packaging. The lid keeps coming unscrewed and tonight it came loose in my pocket at work so it seeped onto my brand new underwear, and also onto my work shirt and of course there’s now a spot on my jeans. Worse, once I collected all the loose product onto my pinkie I had no way to put it back into the package. I hate complaining about packaging because that’s not made in house. That’s ordered from a manufacturer, so. I don’t know if maybe it should do a whole click lock when you screw the cap on, or if a doe foot option might be worth it? I just hate that because void is my favorite I’ve lost a lot of it to the lid coming off so I will repurchase. I love it so so much, but I’m very annoyed to lose so much product when it’s not that cheap.
